products.name: Digital Study Journal
products.description:
A simple, hyperlinked PDF notebook designed to help you organize your study sessions and notes. Made with a cozy dark/sky aesthetic for quiet, focused learning.

✨ WHAT’S INSIDE (1 Interactive PDF):

•Session Tracker: Space to track study blocks (15–60 mins) and log completed sessions.

•Knowledge Base: Pages to organize and tidy up your main notes.

•Mind Map / Grid Pages: Blank layouts for diagrams, skill maps, or freeform writing.

•Next Step Prompts: Small notes to write down where to start next time.

•Hyperlinked Navigation: Clickable tabs to jump between sections and sessions.

✨ DETAILS:
•1x Hyperlinked PDF File
•Undated & Reusable
•Compatible with Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, and other PDF annotation apps on iPad & tablets.

products.name: Language journal
products.description:
Digital Language Learning Journal | Hyperlinked Vocabulary & Grammar Notebook for Goodnotes & iPad

🌘✨
Master any language with this all-in-one Digital Language Journal! Built for structured study, it helps you organize vocabulary, grammar, and learning resources in one aesthetic place.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE THIS PDF PLANNER:
•Vocabulary & Phrases: Templates for words, definitions, translations, and example sentences.
•Grammar & Rules: Categorized tabs for rules, topics, and tricky exceptions.
•Confusables Section: Space to clarify words and rules you often mix up.
•Resource Tracker: Save links to podcasts, books, videos, and articles.
•Plan & Review: Monthly focus, habit tracking, and reflection templates.
•Archive & Sticker Space: Move completed to-do lists and customize pages with digital stickers.

✨ DETAILS:
•1x Interactive PDF file with fully hyperlinked navigation.
•Suitable for learning any language.
•Instant download for Goodnotes, Notability, and all major PDF apps on iPad & tablets.

•To do list, notes and checklist stickers are included. But there's not many of them
